items.headline: Clemson's Swinney irked by plane banner urging FSU to fire Norvell
items.description: Before Florida State's 36-24 loss to Clemson on Saturday night, a plane carrying a banner urging the school to fire Seminoles coach Mike Norvell hovered over Doak Campbell Stadium, a move Tigers coach Dabo Swinney called "embarrassing" and "shameful."

items.headline: Tait Reynolds scores 3 touchdowns in Clemson's 36-24 win over Florida State
items.description: — Tait Reynolds threw a pair of touchdown passes, his first in more than a month, as Clemson jumped out early and held off a late rally, defeating Florida State 36-24 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Clemson OL Elyjah Thurmon stretchered off after hit to helmet
items.description: Clemson starting offensive lineman Elyjah Thurmon was stretchered off the field after taking a helmet-to-helmet hit in the second quarter Saturday against Florida State.
